Each June, we sort the 29,000 accounting ratios into five bins based on their mean long-short returns over the past 30 years (in-sample) and compute the mean return over the next year within each bin (out-of-sample).
Peer-reviewed predictors come from the October 2024 release of the Chen and Zimmermann (2022) (CZ) dataset.
This dataset is built from 212 firm-level variables that were shown to predict returns cross-sectionally in academic journals.

The CZ data is a uniquely accurate representation of the literature: unlike other large-scale replications, CZ show that their t-stats are generally a good match for the t-stats in the original papers.
